head: ae7fa540ca763ed3da8c922a8fc9fde825e1a97b
note: Canonical register merging: phase-a-investigation/confirmed-problems.json (18 problems, June 25) + problem-register.json (9 narrow heal subset, June 5) + 5 new findings discovered during reconciliation

problems.summary: ZST .NET cannot decompress — probe-only inspection tool
problems.direct_evidence: ZstParser.cs line 21: 'Does NOT decompress — probe-only for metadata extraction'. ZstDocument has no DecompressedContent or Decompress() method.
problems.corrected_fix: ZstdSharp.Port NuGet (MIT license, pure managed, cross-platform). API: Decompressor.Unwrap() and DecompressionStream.
hardening_required: PROB-009 gap taxonomy (blocks gap entry creation)

problems.summary: FODS PDF exporter Latin-1 only — Unicode commercial blocker
problems.direct_evidence: FodsPdfExporter.cs: Latin-1 limitation confirmed. Helvetica only.
problems.corrected_fix: Option A: TrueType font embedding. Option B: PdfSharp NuGet. Option C: Document as Latin-1-scoped product.

problems.summary: FODT FodtBody.Paragraphs skips tables and lists
problems.direct_evidence: FodtBody.cs line 30: 'Does not recurse into tables or lists — top-level only'. Spec/Table/ stubs exist but unexposed in public API.
problems.corrected_fix: Add FodtBody.Tables property with FodtTable/FodtTableCell public model. Parser must populate from table elements.

problems.summary: HTML/Markdown/TXT .NET projects counted as format products
problems.direct_evidence: Three target-writer projects exist in src/net/ with no parse/load capability.

problems.summary: CSV .NET no edit API
problems.direct_evidence: Prior sprint added query methods (IsEmpty, GetCellValue, Filter, HasColumn) per MEMORY.md TC-S55-007. But AddRow/SetCell/RemoveRow not confirmed.
problems.corrected_fix: Verify query methods present. Add mutation methods if missing: AddRow, SetCell, RemoveRow.
problems.note: Need to read CsvDocument.cs to confirm current state

problems.summary: FODP Python no write_fodp — read/export only
problems.direct_evidence: fodp_codec.py has export functions but no write_fodp().
problems.corrected_fix: Implement write_fodp(model, path) using flat ODP XML structure. Reference write_fodg() as pattern.

problems.summary: [CORRECTED] ODS Python has write_ods()
problems.resolution: Initial assessment was wrong. write_ods() exists in ods_writer.py.

problems.summary: [CORRECTED] PBM/PGM/PPM Python have write_* functions
problems.resolution: Initial assessment was wrong. write_pbm, write_pgm, write_ppm all exist.

problems.summary: Gap taxonomy broken — 1207/1208 gaps category 'MISSING' (was 'unknown', still uninformative)
problems.direct_evidence: gap-ledger.json: 1208 total, 1207 category='MISSING', 1 category='missing_implementation'. Category renamed 'unknown'→'MISSING' by subsequent sprint but no actual taxonomy repair occurred.
problems.corrected_fix: Implement deterministic category inference from gap content. Define 8-12 category buckets. Migrate existing entries. Add validator: >50% MISSING blocks sprint generation.

problems.summary: SAL chain broken for 10/20 Python formats
problems.direct_evidence: MEMORY.md confirms 10 CHAIN_BROKEN_AT_SAL: ABW, CSV, DIF, GNUMERIC, NDJSON, SYLK, TOML, TSV, XCF, ZST.
problems.corrected_fix: Build SAL extractors for missing format specs. Priority: CSV (RFC 4180), TOML spec, SYLK spec.

problems.summary: LLM grader silently degrades evidence quality without API keys
problems.direct_evidence: MEMORY.md: 'evidence_quality_zero is now just a warning (not blocking).' Items get DEFERRED_WITH_REASON when LLM unavailable.
problems.corrected_fix: Implement local deterministic grader fallback OR add explicit UNVERIFIED_EXTERNAL_GRADER state. Block continuation if DEFERRED > 20%.

problems.summary: autonomous_cycle.py (2406 LOC) and governance_validators.py (3181 LOC) violate their own caps
problems.corrected_fix: Extract analytics/extensions from autonomous_cycle.py. Split governance_validators.py into modules.

problems.summary: FodsOdsExporter PROTOTYPE in source, PASS in poc-targets — false authority claim
problems.direct_evidence: FodsOdsExporter.cs: 'PROTOTYPE STATUS: design_complete_in_progress'. poc-targets.yaml PASS claim for ods_exporter capability.
problems.corrected_fix: Option A: Complete the exporter and verify with LibreOffice open test. Option B: Downgrade poc-targets from PASS to PARTIAL with explanation.

problems.summary: Analytics masquerade: gnumeric_workbook_stats.py, toml/config_document.py misnamed
problems.direct_evidence: MEMORY.md: GAP-PROD-INV-MASQ-001 is 'deferred governance debt, requires 16+ import changes'.
problems.corrected_fix: Rename to gnumeric_analytics.py, toml_analytics.py. Update all imports.

problems.summary: Skills with empty implementation_paths — no code enforcement
problems.corrected_fix: For each active skill: add implementation paths or mark advisory_only.

problems.summary: FodsOdsExporter may not produce valid ODS ZIP (overlaps PROB-013)
problems.resolution: Same underlying issue as PROB-013. Will be resolved by PROB-013 fix.

problems.summary: ci_transcript_verification in backlog — skill transcripts not enforced in CI
problems.corrected_fix: Implement and wire ci_transcript_verification into sprint execution pipeline.

problems.summary: ZST Python analytics-heavy codec — zst_analytics.py extracted per MEMORY.md
problems.resolution: zst_analytics.py created. Core codec may still be large. LOW severity; verify LOC.

problems.summary: Authorization policy overly conservative — false blockers misclassified as human gates
problems.corrected_fix: Clarify AGENTS.md: 'no unsolicited docs' vs 'no docs when full product healing mission is active'

problems.summary: CLAIM-004 (no pyproject.toml) is stale — all 20 packages now have pyproject.toml
ZST .csproj header says NOT approved — inconsistent with Netpbm/FODS/FODT which were updated
problems.corrected_fix: Update ZstParser.cs and ZstDocument.cs header comments to remove incorrect 'NOT approved' language, or verify ZST Gate 11 status in poc-targets.yaml.

problems.summary: FodsOdsExporter Gate 11 status comment 'G11-G NOT approved' — inconsistent with FODS Gate 11 APPROVED
problems.note: FodsOdsExporter.cs says 'G11-G NOT approved' while poc-targets.yaml says Gate 11 APPROVED for FODS. The ODS exporter is a FODS component, so the approval status should match or be explicitly scoped.
problems.corrected_fix: Either update the comment to match the FODS Gate 11 approval scope, or document that ODS exporter is specifically excluded from the Gate 11 approval scope.
